name: gtm-strategy-canvas
description: Evidence-led GTM strategy work using the repository's adaptive 12-block Canvas, decision logic, evidence assessment, Strategic Decision Records, consistency checks, and readiness levels.

interface.longDescription: An adaptive GTM strategy skill for product marketers, product leaders, and founders. Uses the repository's canonical 12-block Canvas, decision logic, evidence statuses, Strategic Decision Records, cross-Canvas consistency checks, readiness levels, research protocol, QA rules, and editable PowerPoint output specification. This is an instruction-only skill: it does not include connected data sources, external research APIs, or an automatic PowerPoint-generation tool.
interface.defaultPrompt: @GTM Strategy Canvas Help me develop an evidence-backed GTM strategy for my product.
